title: stachys recta subsp. doerfleri
intro: Stachys recta subsp. doerfleri, commonly known as doerfler's betony, is a subspecies of the Stachys recta plant, which is a type of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The health benefits of doerfler's betony include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
